reply.text: That soreness question is really one about whether it's normal pain response versus something off — and that's outside what I can call from here. If it's sharp, sticks around a long time, or feels like a joint issue rather than muscle soreness, get it checked by a doctor or physio and we'll train around whatever they say. Nothing's set up in a program for you right now, so I can't tell you what's next from here — if you expect one, check the Workouts tab or let me know what you're trying to build. In the meantime, keep an eye on that soreness and get it looked at if it's more than normal muscle fatigue.
